integrationNotes: The selected runtime is exposed as OCR(x, y, w, h, lang) and is reused by .IL TESSER_DETECT labels. The UI still does not provide OCR authoring or preview controls.
The tiny recognizer excludes Japanese and must not replace small as the multilingual default.
Use explicit line mode for known single-row ROIs; use detection for general multi-line ROIs.
Preserve raw text, confidence and boxes. Whitespace normalization is a benchmark metric, not an automatic API transformation.
Synthetic evidence does not establish real game accuracy. Validate actual capture-card frames before enabling automated decisions.
